result:
Quiz 0001, submission s2: 4 correct, 1 partial, 1 wrong.

| Item | Verdict | Feedback |
|---|---|---|
| q1 | Correct | What makes it an agent is the loop: choose an action, run it, feed the result back. A longer prompt or a bigger context window doesn't change that structure. |
| q2 | Correct | The model only outputs a structured request naming the tool and its arguments. The program around it runs the tool. |
| q3 | **Wrong** (M6) | The agent repeats the same edit against the same failing test, so 40 more steps add nothing. Nothing in the loop ends it by itself. The program needs a stopping condition, such as a step limit that halts and reports to a person. |
| q4 | Correct | 4 is right: three tool requests plus the final answer, one per call. Fix one wording slip. The model doesn't run `check_calendar` or the other tools. Each call ends with a request, the program runs the tool, then calls the model again with the result. |
| q5 | Correct | The result goes back in as the model's next input so the model can decide what to do next. |
| q6 | Partial | The name is part of it, but the model chooses from the full description. That covers the name, what the tool does and when to use it, and its parameters. A name alone can mislead. For example, `check_calendar` doesn't say whether it books or only reads. |

**Summary:** You have the agent loop down. You saw that the model only requests a tool and the program runs it, you counted model calls correctly, and you explained why the result goes back to the model. Two things to work on:
- **Stopping:** an agent that repeats itself won't fix itself by running longer. The program needs a limit that ends the loop.
- **Roles and tool choice:** keep the model and the program separate in your wording. In q4 you wrote that the model runs the tools. A model also picks a tool from its whole description, not just its name.

**Next step:** reread these before you try again.
- The "Agents" section of [Building effective agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents) (q3). Look for the line about stopping conditions such as a maximum number of iterations.
- "Model responses with tools" in [Define tools](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/define-tools) (q4). The model's reply holds a `tool_use` block with a name and an input, which is a request and not a result.
- "Best practices for tool definitions" in the same [Define tools](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/define-tools) page (q6). Look for what a good description says beyond the name.

The grades are in `grades/0001-s2.json`.
